about: Upstream paths whose changes need a security review before an upstream update is merged, beyond what patches/ touch. Used by scripts/upstream_report.mjs. A trailing /** matches everything below a directory.

groups.reason: Security headers: Mastodon's server sets them, Teadeck replaces them with container/nginx.conf. A change here (e.g. a new CSP directive the client needs, or a tightened one) must be mirrored there.

HTML and URL sanitizing: Mastodon sanitizes on its server, and the web client renders that HTML as delivered. Teadeck receives HTML from any instance, so a fix moved into or relying on these places may need a client-side counterpart.
Replaced by Teadeck: startup, login/OAuth, the service worker and the page shell. A security fix here does not reach Teadeck by itself; check integration/ for the counterpart.
